# #5006: Patch: revisit the AI's Burn and Toxic weights after the Stinkyscape+ sweep
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A unit or hero with Burn or Toxic counters still to come is worth less in the AI's eyes: half a point of value per point of damage on the way, over the next four turn starts. Those halves were starting guesses, left with a note to revisit after fullsend 2's Stinkyscape+ sweep, and the sweep has since run and cleared while the guesses never moved. Once built, the AI prices burning and poisoned boards at what 400 paired games say they are worth instead of at the guess. A player meets it as a practice opponent that values attrition boards more sanely, for example paying the measured price, when it trades or walls, for a unit that will take a Toxic tick, instead of the guessed half.

## Why

- [config.rs](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/crates/ai/src/config.rs) (R3822000) calls `unit_affliction`, `unit_doomed` and `hero_affliction` (0.5 each) `untuned starts, to revisit after #3574's sweep`. The sweep ran ([sweep-2026-11-13.md](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/training/history/sweep-2026-11-13.md), R3574000) and neither the comment nor any open or recent issue records the revisit.
- The smoke gate cannot distinguish the guess from zero: 20, 18 and 18 of 20 at 0.5 against 19, 18 and 18 at 0, all above the 19/14/15 floors. [SPEC §9.9](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md) says a gate of this size catches a broken AI, not a lost point or two, and a claim about strength needs hundreds of fresh deals, not the gate.
- Burn and Toxic are live Stinkyscape+ mechanics the AI meets in practice: Noxious Rounds (Toxic), Volcanic Rounds (Burn since #4783, R4783001), and the Force Projector and Oct damage pools (R4064000), read over `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS` (4) turn starts.
- `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps all three weights at 0 as the frozen yardstick the gates were fixed on; the change must leave it there.

## Proposal

- One deal screen exactly as [training/improve.md](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/training/improve.md) (A screen) prescribes: build a control from the tip, then screen `unit_affliction` at 1.0 against the 0.5 control with `unit_doomed` and `hero_affliction` held (one change, size fixed in advance: 400 games on improve-dev). Keep it only if `edgeLow` is above 0, otherwise revert per R4319000, and record the tally (control commit, edge, decided wonBoth/lostBoth, diverged) in the `AI_EVAL` comment.
- Hold the kept value with extended scenes in [affliction_threat.rs](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs) that fail without it; never weaken an existing scene. Leave `GREEDY_EVAL` at 0. Re-record the practice-claim fixture with the change ([training/README.md](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/training/README.md), The practice-claim fixture), since decisions change.
- If the screen is inconclusive, close it out with the screen recorded; a different arm (for example 0.25) is a separate future screen, never a re-read of this one.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: the `AI_EVAL` affliction trio only.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs`: scenes pinning the kept value.
- `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json`: re-recorded with the change.
- No spec change (a number, not a rule) and no ruling; [SPEC §9.9](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md)'s evaluation paragraph already describes the ticks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deal screen run on improve-dev with its control commit and tally recorded in the config comment.
- [ ] Kept value has `edgeLow` above 0, or the knob is reverted with the inconclusive screen recorded.
- [ ] New or extended `affliction_threat.rs` scenes fail without the kept value.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are green.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke) still clears its floors.
- [ ] The practice-claim fixture is re-recorded with the change and its tests pass.

## Size and risks

Medium work, difficulty hard (AI tuning). The bulk is one 400-game deal screen, about 25 to 45 minutes on two cores per improve.md, plus config and scene tests. Main risk is an inconclusive screen, which most tuning screens are; then the change is reverted per R4319000 and only the recorded screen and any kept scenes remain. No design call, no gate or yardstick change.

- **For a person, only if the tally reads conclusive with `edgeLow` > 0:** should the AI take 1.0?
